newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEDO fuel oil tender validity extended by 24 hours.
newsitem.headline: KEDO fuel oil tender validity extended by 24 hours.

text.p: The Korean Peninsular Energy Development Organisation (KEDO) has extended the validity date for its latest tender to buy fuel oil by one day to November 8, industry sources said on Friday.
KEDO's tender to buy 42,000 tonnes of 2.0-percent sulphur grade heavy residual fuel oil for delivery between November 10-29 was scheduled to close November 6 and was valid until November 7.
"The validity has been extended for another 24 hours," said a trader in South Korea. "Results are due early Saturday morning."
The cargo is to be delivered to the ports of Sonbong, Nampo or Songrim in North Korea.
KEDO, an international organization established to implement nuclear non-proliferation in North Korea, has agreed to supply the country with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil annually.
